g.text: HOTEL RESERVATION PLATFORM · AZURE HUB AND SPOKE · ONE REGION
Spoke traffic leaves through the hub firewall, and the booking data stays off the address space

The booking cluster runs in a spoke VNet peered to the hub, and the hub firewall inspects what leaves the spoke. The cluster reaches room photos in Azure Storage, reservations in Azure SQL Database and its secrets in Azure Key
Vault through private endpoints in its own VNet. Azure Front Door takes guest traffic and Microsoft Entra ID signs in staff, both outside the region.
SKU and scale units from the Azure Bastion doc
